identity.name: link_parcel_abutments
identity.description: Links every parcel to the parcels that abut it (shared boundary >= abut_min_shared_len_m) into parcel_abutments, one row per ordered pair, with the neighbour's residential flag, same-frontage-street flag, primary building, building-to-subject distance and an advisory estimated front setback. Observations only: front-yard-averaging applicability (10.5.40.70(1)) is derived on read by McBylaw.

why_lock.text: Mutual exclusion with every other writer of parcel_abutments (Spec 47 §A.5: the spec number 130 is globally unique). The shell keeps `const ADVISORY_LOCK_ID = 130;` as a §5.4 source-text constant, asserted equal by the pipeline advisory-lock suite.

write_discipline.scope: parcel_id IN (SELECT id FROM parcels WHERE geom IS NOT NULL)

why.text: The junction is re-derived, not reloaded: every run (staleness.mode_select none, full_rescan — Q-B3 full rescan, adjudicated 2026-10-14) walks every parcel with geometry and upserts both orientations of every derived pair behind an IS DISTINCT FROM guard over every value column (linked_at is the run clock and is never a guard term, LG-9), so an unchanged re-run writes zero rows and a relinked building or renamed frontage street is picked up by the next run. Pair EXISTENCE depends only on the two geometries: a material geometry change deletes the parcel's pairs in both orientations (migration 255 trigger) and a parcel delete cascades (FK). Distances are rounded to the NUMERIC(10,2) column scale so the guard is stable.

invalidates.when: a parcel's geometry, a neighbour's primary building (link_massing) or a parcel's frontage street (enrich_centreline) changes. O4 rows 5/7 precedent (link_massing, link_parcels): link_parcel_abutments re-derives every pair of every parcel with geometry on every run (staleness.mode_select "none"), so resolveLinkGate always resolves mode full and the next run picks the change up; linked_at moves only on rows whose values moved (IS DISTINCT FROM guard).

why.text: One write statement reaches parcel_abutments: the per-batch guarded upsert. There is no retraction (retract none under full_rescan, O4 row 5): pairs that stop abutting are removed by the migration-255 trigger or the parcels FK cascade.

LDG-10 / S1-P producer edge (watermark, not evaluated): the neighbour's primary building comes from parcel_buildings; under full_rescan every run re-reads it, so no incremental scope keys on this stamp.
LDG-10 / S1-P producer edge (watermark, not evaluated): primary_frontage_street_name is enrich_centreline's output; re-read every run under full_rescan.
LDG-10 / S1-P producer edge (watermark, not evaluated): neighbour_residential reads parcels.zoning_class, enrich_parcels' pass-1 output; re-read every run under full_rescan.
Every pair is found and measured with PostGIS (ST_DWithin, ST_Intersection, ST_Distance in EPSG 2952); there is no second code path.
The self-join finds neighbours through the parcels GiST index; without it the set-based join degrades to a nested scan over 496K parcels (the per-lot form measured 50 ms/lot, about 6 h, is refused).
The neighbour frontage-street geometry is gathered through the centreline GiST index.

Migration 255 enables RLS on parcel_abutments with ZERO policies (Spec 114 Class B). Under a non-bypass role the guarded upsert affects 0 rows with NO error, so the counters read 0 and the verdict reads PASS. The bypass is the precondition, checked before the first read (load_coa_notices precedent).

Migration 255, a presence precondition, not an invalidator row (R-CR; checked presence-only, the link_massing trg_parcels_geom_invalidation form): a material parcels.geom change deletes the parcel's pairs in both orientations, so a pair that stops abutting through a geometry edit is removed (there is no retraction under full_rescan); without the trigger an edited lot would keep its stale pairs.

on_check_error_why.text: Every check reads a value the library already measured (the join counters, the write counters, the post-write table query), so a check that throws is a defect: it must redden the run.

expect.reports: the mode decision and its reason (full / full_rescan on every run)

why.text: Records the runner's gate (resolveLinkGate: full / full_rescan under mode_select none) so the audit table says how every run was scoped; it RECORDS, it never decides (Rule 10). INFO under the Rule 10 exception for a purely descriptive row: violations is always 0 and the gate decision is in detail.

The denominator of this run: every parcel with geometry (full_rescan, every run). INFO under the Rule 10 exception for a purely descriptive counter that no threshold can bound: violations is always 0 and the count lives in detail.

expect.reports: rows inserted and updated by the guarded upsert

why.text: Zero on an unchanged re-run is the idempotency evidence (full_rescan behind the IS DISTINCT FROM guard). INFO under the Rule 10 exception for a purely descriptive counter that no threshold can bound: violations is always 0 and the count lives in detail.

Adjacency is symmetric and every batch emits both orientations; an asymmetric pair means a partial write (a geometry edit deletes both orientations through the migration-255 trigger, so it never leaves one side), measured over the whole table after every run.

expect.reports: rows per est_status over the whole table

why.text: The closed est_status census the Reality-Check bounds read (research: 4 of 378 estimates negative; p50 6.73 m on RD). INFO under the Rule 10 exception for a purely descriptive counter that no threshold can bound: violations is always 0 and the count lives in detail.

expect.reports: CUMULATIVE percentage of parcels with geometry that have at least one abutment row

checks.retighten_when: the first capture (H6 runbook step 5) measures the share: abut_parcels_with_abutments_warn_pct is then re-set from 50 (a loose provisional floor) to just under the measured value, so a join, tolerance or pad regression that collapses the share WARNs.

why.text: Most urban lots have neighbours; a collapse of this share is a join, tolerance or search-pad regression (limitations[2]). A threshold exists, so it is not a purely descriptive counter (R-H, Spec 124 §5 Rule 10): WARN on a config floor, the fleet LINK form of link_neighbourhoods link_rate (field_coverage, pct >=, limit_from_config). QA ruling 2026-10-16 item 2 (.cursor/h6-qa-ruling-2026-10-16.md). The floor is provisional until the first capture measures the share.

limitations.what: A pair that stops qualifying without a MATERIAL geometry change is not deleted by a re-run (there is no retraction under full_rescan); its values are frozen at the last run that derived it. Every cause: (1) a tunable change — abut_touch_tolerance_m, abut_min_shared_len_m or abut_bbox_pad_deg (the pad narrows the search, limitations[2]); (2) a method change (staleness.logic_version); (3) a geometry edit below the trigger's material-change tolerance (migration 255 trg_parcels_abutments_invalidation fires only when public.parcels_geom_materially_changed, tolerance parcels_geom_change_tolerance_deg), which can still drop shared_len_m below the minimum. After (1) or (2) the operator resets the junction (recovery.reset). Precedent for a declared, check-less staleness class: enrich-heritage.descriptor.json FOLD-I5 limitation. QA ruling 2026-10-16 item 3 (keep the limitation; no partial check).
limitations.measured: declared: pair existence = f(geom, abut_touch_tolerance_m, abut_min_shared_len_m, abut_bbox_pad_deg); material geom changes are trigger-invalidated, sub-tolerance geom edits and tunable or method changes are not. No check observes such a pair: it stays symmetric, so asymmetric_pairs cannot see it.

limitations.what: front_setback_est_m is measured to the building OUTLINE (massing roof outline incl. eaves/porches), not the main wall (800.50): fidelity `differs` (Spec 69 M-26). It is advisory only until an estimator passes the CoA-notice oracle (Q-B1).
limitations.measured: research 2026-10-07: method v2 within 0.5 m on 2 of 9 CoA-notice oracle parcels

limitations.what: The neighbour search is a degree bbox pad (abut_bbox_pad_deg) before a geography ST_DWithin in metres (abut_touch_tolerance_m); each is bounded on its own, so an operator who raises the tolerance above the pad's ground distance (about 1.6 m E-W at the default) silently narrows the search to the pad.

recovery.reset: After a tunable or logic_version change that can drop pairs: DELETE FROM parcel_abutments (an operator action, H-lane) then re-run — every run re-derives every pair, so the re-run IS the rebuild. Otherwise a plain re-run is the repair: values that moved are rewritten through the guarded upsert.

interrupted_why.text: full_rescan (mode_select none): there is no incremental mode for a crash to be followed by and nothing to force; no write target is a destructive retraction (retract none), so a run killed mid-loop leaves earlier batches committed and the next run's full re-derive repairs the rest.

before_image_why.text: No write target retracts (retract none); the only deletes are the migration-255 trigger's and the FK cascade's, both outside the step. The junction is fully derivable from parcels, parcel_buildings, building_footprints and toronto_centreline.

why.text: asymmetric_pairs WARNed: the run completed and the stale pairs are named in the audit row.
No parcel has geometry: nothing to derive (the empty_source guard on parcels normally halts first).
A guards.requires precondition (PostGIS, a GiST index) is missing; nothing is written.
Advisory lock 130 is held by another process; the library emits a row-derived SKIP summary.
